ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Finance majors. Remaining seats will be opened to Gies College of Business majors and Actuarial Science three weeks after priority registration begins. Enrollments are kept even and seats will be slowly added to all sections of FIN 300 simultaneously.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Finance or Information Sys & Info Tech or Accountancy or Actuarial Science or Marketing or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Information Systems or Operations Management major(s).
